verdict.rationale: Smooth's own docs say its agent can compile research and return summarized results (smooth-docs-30), explore your web app and report issues (smooth-docs-32), and gather status updates from sites (smooth-docs-33). These are AI-generated findings, but about web content the agent browses, not insights over the user's own data surfaced inside the product. missing for 10: in-product insights or suggestions over the user's own data, documentation of any insight or recommendation feature, independent or hands-on corroboration.
